reference.title: Refactored genetic codes enable bidirectional genetic isolation

target.condition: Agar plates ± spectinomycin; spotted cells; overnight incubation; medium/temperature unknown (requires_supplement)

trigger.observation: Prior observation (ref 18, confirmed here) that canonical-code SpecR is not read in Syn61Δ3; hypothesis that code compression provides no barrier to information escape because the compressed code is a subset of the canonical code.
trigger.reasoning: Test whether compressed genetic codes provide a barrier to genetic-information flow (functionality of canonical vs compressed resistance genes in canonical vs compressed decoding hosts)

evidence.source_location: Same gene in cognate-decoder cells (positive) and non-cognate cells (negative); no-drug plates

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Direct functional measurement (growth on selective plates) of the constructed gene in both hosts.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Introduction of SpecR WT or recoded recSpecR(ΔTCG,TCA) (codon-compressed spectinomycin resistance gene); analogous hygromycin constructs (fig. S1)

result.after: SpecR WT functional only in canonical cells; recSpecR functional in both — compressed codes are nonorthogonal

decision_chain.rule: A gene recoded to use only a subset of canonical codons remains readable by canonical translation machinery; codon compression alone cannot prevent information flow to natural organisms — orthogonality requires sense-codon reassignment, not just compression.

target.condition: Conjugation assay; transconjugants counted per ~10^6 cells; details requires_supplement

trigger.observation: SpecR WT functional only in canonical cells; recSpecR functional in both — compressed codes are nonorthogonal
trigger.reasoning: Test whether code compression plus cognate tRNA deletion blocks conjugative transfer of a canonical-code mobile element, and probe rare escape events

evidence.description: Transconjugant colony counts; sequencing of 2 escape clones (Fig. 1E, fig. S2, data file S1)
evidence.source_location: F(WT) transfer into Syn61 WT (positive control for conjugation efficiency)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 自动判定失败——请人工判定
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Conjugation of F(WT) plasmid from canonical-code donors into recipients; selection for transfer into Syn61Δ2

result.metric: Transconjugant colony counts; sequencing of 2 escape clones (Fig. 1E, fig. S2, data file S1)
result.after: F(WT) not transferred to Syn61Δ3; rare transfer into Syn61Δ2 via acquisition of donor serT

trigger.observation: Sequencing of the 2 Syn61Δ2 escape clones showed they had acquired donor sequences containing serT.
trigger.reasoning: Test sufficiency of serT carriage to restore transfer of a canonical-code mobile element into Syn61Δ3

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Direct conjugation measurement with the engineered element.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Construction of F(WT + serT): F(WT) variant carrying serT (tRNA_UGA^Ser), then conjugation

result.after: F(WT+serT) transferred to both Syn61 WT and Syn61Δ3; transfer dependent on serT

decision_chain.rule: Mobile genetic elements that carry tRNAs decoding a host's deleted codons can breach isolation based on codon compression plus tRNA deletion; biocontainment by codon deletion must also account for element-borne translation factors.

target.condition: Expression in Syn61Δ3 with sfGFP (codon position 3) or ubiquitin (position 11) reporters; details requires_supplement

trigger.observation: Need for tRNAs that direct incorporation of distinct canonical amino acids at TCG/TCA to refactor code structure (Fig. 2A concept).
trigger.reasoning: Reassign TCG/TCA codons to non-serine canonical amino acids via anticodon-mutated tRNAs (rational candidates)

evidence.description: ESI-MS amino-acid identity at reassigned codon; protein yields (fig. S3); growth comparison (fig. S15)
evidence.source_location: Mass-spectrometric comparison against expected masses; specificity checked against other TCN codons (figs. S6, S7)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Amino-acid incorporation measured directly by mass spectrometry.

alternatives.approach: Remaining Ala/His/Leu/Pro reassigners beyond the rational candidates were instead found through a screen (fig. S14)

decision_chain.implementation_detail: Introduction of chimeric alanyl- and leucyl-tRNAs with anticodons altered to CGA or UGA (Watson-Crick complement of TCG/TCA), pairwise combinations

result.metric: ESI-MS amino-acid identity at reassigned codon; protein yields (fig. S3); growth comparison (fig. S15)
result.after: Specific incorporation of parent-isoacceptor amino acid; tRNA_UGA^Leu lower fidelity; chimeric tRNAs decode the exact Watson-Crick complement codon

decision_chain.rule: When reassigning a codon through tRNA anticodon mutation, prefer isoacceptor tRNAs whose anticodon is not an aminoacyl-tRNA-synthetase identity element, because these are more likely to retain correct aminoacylation after anticodon swap.

target.condition: Same sfGFP/ubiquitin ESI-MS readout system as E4a

trigger.observation: Ala/Leu rational candidates succeeded; equivalent reassigners for His and Pro could not be assumed a priori and had to be found empirically.
trigger.reasoning: Identify additional reassignment tRNAs (His, Pro) to complete the 4×4 matrix of 16 genetic codes

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Screen output verified by mass spectrometry of reporter proteins.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Screen of anticodon-mutated tRNAs (fig. S14) to find His and Pro reassigners; pairwise introduction into Syn61Δ3

result.after: 16 genetic codes with TCG/TCA independently reassigned to Ala/His/Leu/Pro; expansion of Ala/Pro codon boxes 4→6, His 2→4, Leu 6→8; UCN box split

trigger.observation: E1 showed compressed genes are read by canonical cells (nonorthogonal); E4 showed TCG/TCA can be reassigned to other amino acids — combining both motivates a gene whose codons require reassigned decoding.
trigger.reasoning: Create and validate a synthetic gene written in an orthogonal code that is readable only by the cognate orthogonal decoder

evidence.source_location: SpecR WT in both hosts; O-SpecR in canonical-decoding cells (negative)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured function (resistance) in defined decoder backgrounds.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Gene design/synthesis: O-SpecR(TCG-Ala,TCA-His) — recSpecR(ΔTCG,TCA) with all 27 GCN (Ala) codons→TCG and all 6 CAT/C (His) codons→TCA; extended to 6 other reassignment schemes and other genes (fig. S16)

result.after: O-SpecR functional only in cognate orthogonal cells; SpecR WT nonfunctional in orthogonal cells — functionally orthogonal code–decoder pair

decision_chain.rule: Designing a synthetic gene to maximize the number of codons subject to reassignment maximizes its functional orthogonality to the canonical code; pairing such genes with the cognate reassigned-decoder host yields bidirectional isolation.

trigger.observation: E5 established orthogonal gene–decoder pairs; extending the principle to an entire mobile element (with an essential recoded gene) tests whether transfer itself can be confined to code-matched hosts.
trigger.reasoning: Build orthogonal and mutually orthogonal HGT systems by recoding a conjugative mobile element
source_location: other reassigned-decoder strains for the 5-system matrix

evidence.description: Transconjugant colony counts; heat map of donor×recipient matrix (Fig. 4B/C; fig. S17)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Direct conjugation measurements across the donor×recipient matrix.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Synthesis of O-F1(TCG-Ala,TCA-His): all annotated F-plasmid ORFs code-compressed (Syn61 scheme); essential replication gene trfA recoded (GCN→TCG, CAT/C→TCA); conjugation into matched/mismatched recipients

result.metric: Transconjugant colony counts; heat map of donor×recipient matrix (Fig. 4B/C; fig. S17)
result.after: O-F1 transferred only to compatible orthogonal-decoder cells; five mutually orthogonal HGT systems demonstrated (scalability)

decision_chain.rule: Recoding a gene essential for a mobile element's replication into an orthogonal code confines the element's horizontal transfer to hosts carrying the cognate decoder; stacking multiple reassigned codons in essential genes strengthens isolation.

trigger.observation: E3 showed serT-carrying elements still transfer to Syn61Δ3; reassignment alone only obstructs (~10^4-fold) because invading tRNA_UGA^Ser competes with reassigned tRNAs — escapees remain.
trigger.reasoning: Block invasion by mobile elements that carry their own decoding tRNAs, by locking the orthogonal code into an essential host gene
source_location: Syn61Δ3(tRNA_CGA^Ala, tRNA_UGA^His, O-SpecR[TCG-Ala,TCA-His]) and analogous code-locked strains (other codes/essential genes, figs. S18–S19)

evidence.source_location: No-spectinomycin condition (unlocked baseline); F(WT+serT) into Syn61Δ3 without code locking (E3)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured transconjugant counts with and without selection; complete ablation observed under the stated condition and detection limit.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Code locking: host carries O-SpecR; spectinomycin selection makes Ala-decoding of TCG and His-decoding of TCA essential ('locked in'); challenge with F(WT+serT) ± spectinomycin

result.after: Transfer obstructed ~10^4-fold without selection (competing tRNAs cause stochastic misdecoding) and completely ablated under selection; generalizes to other codes and essential genes

decision_chain.rule: Locking reassigned codons into a conditionally essential gene converts partial obstruction into complete ablation of invading mobile elements, including elements carrying their own tRNAs; the essentiality is conditional on the selective agent, not constitutive.

target.condition: Plaque assays in presence of spectinomycin; inputs 1.1×10^10 PFU/ml (phage 12) and 7.5×10^9 PFU/ml (phage 06)

trigger.observation: Isolated phage 06/12 carry tRNA_UGA^Ser — the same class of element-borne decoder shown in E3 to breach compression-based isolation.
trigger.reasoning: Test whether code-locked refactored strains resist viral invasion, using environmental phages that carry their own tRNA

evidence.description: Plaque counts (Fig. 5D; figs. S20–S22); phage genome de novo assembly; data file S4
evidence.source_location: Syn61Δ3 as susceptible host; T4 without tRNA expression as noninfectious control

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Direct plaque assays measuring infectivity.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Isolation of phage pools from River Cam; isolation of T4-like phage 06 and 12 (carry identical tRNA_UGA^Ser); plaque assays; in a linked validation, expression of tRNA_UGA^Ser in Syn61Δ3 to test susceptibility to otherwise noninfectious T4 (fig. S21)

result.metric: Plaque counts (Fig. 5D; figs. S20–S22); phage genome de novo assembly; data file S4
result.after: Phage 06/12 infect Syn61Δ3 but not code-locked strains; tRNA_UGA^Ser expression confers T4 susceptibility on Syn61Δ3

decision_chain.rule: Viruses carrying their own translation factors can invade codon-compressed hosts; sense-codon reassignment locked into essential genes protects against such tRNA-carrying viruses.

engineering_problem.problem_statement: Refactor the structure of the genetic code in Escherichia coli by reassigning sense codons (TCG/TCA) to distinct canonical amino acids, in order to create orthogonal genetic codes that (i) restrict escape of synthetic genetic information into natural life, (ii) enable orthogonal and mutually orthogonal horizontal gene transfer systems, and (iii) when locked into essential genes, block invasion by mobile genetic elements including tRNA-carrying viruses.

target_strains.paper_strain_normalized: Escherichia coli Syn61 (recoded genome: TCG/TCA→AGC/AGT, TAG→TAA)
target_strains.paper_label: Syn61 WT; 'WT' here denotes canonical decoding capacity, not a natural wild-type isolate — Syn61 is a fully synthetic-recoded genome
target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Constructed by prior work (Fredens et al. 2019, ref 14); serves as the canonical-code-reading reference strain in this paper
target_strains.reasoning: Named in Fig. 1 caption and Results as the canonical-decoding strain.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Evolved from Syn61 and deleted for serU, serT and prfA (prior work, ref 18); the chassis into which all reassigned tRNAs and orthogonal genes are introduced in this paper
target_strains.reasoning: Genotype explicitly described in Introduction; used throughout as recipient/host.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Syn61 deleted for serU and serT but retaining prfA; used specifically as recipient in the F(WT) escape-selection experiment because TAG-containing selection was compatible with prfA presence
target_strains.reasoning: Defined parenthetically in the escape-selection paragraph.

target_strains.paper_strain_raw: Syn61D3(tRNA_CGA^Ala, tRNA_UGA^His) and 15 further tRNA-pair variants
target_strains.paper_strain_normalized: Escherichia coli Syn61Δ3 bearing anticodon-mutated isoacceptor tRNAs in pairwise combinations (Ala/His/Leu/Pro × CGA/UGA anticodons; 16 genetic codes)
target_strains.paper_label: reassigned-code strains; code-locked strains when additionally carrying O-SpecR under spectinomycin
target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Created in this paper by introducing chimeric tRNAs into Syn61Δ3; the Ala/His combination is the exemplar in Figs. 3–5
target_strains.combination_status: demonstrated (each pairwise tRNA combination directly shown in Fig. 2B; code-locked derivatives shown in Fig. 5C/D)
target_strains.genotype: Syn61Δ3 + tRNA_X^aa pairs with CGA or UGA anticodons (aa ∈ {Ala, His, Leu, Pro}); code-locked versions additionally carry O-SpecR(TCG-Ala,TCA-His) or other orthogonal essential genes
target_strains.reasoning: 16-code matrix stated in text and Fig. 2C; whether tRNAs are plasmid- or genome-borne requires_supplement (data file S5 lists plasmid accessions).

target_strains.paper_strain_normalized: T4-like bacteriophages 06 and 12 isolated from River Cam water
target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Environmental isolates selected for ability to infect Syn61Δ3; both carry an identical tRNA_UGA^Ser gene
target_strains.reasoning: Isolation source and tRNA carriage stated in Results; genome sequences in data file S4.
